steps.title: Open the Desk
steps.narration: Go to the Desk page to see your research panels.
steps.point_out: The Desk page displays your research panels, including Hypothesis Foundry.

steps.title: Check the Foundry era
steps.narration: Expand the Foundry section to see the current research era. It opened as a new era, and the old automatic loop is now stopped.
steps.point_out: The current era is hypothesis-foundry (active). The previous era, rapid-microscope, is closed. Backend status is shown below.

steps.title: Review source specifications
steps.narration: Expand Sources. Each source compiles into a specification without reading outcomes first. This proves no bias shapes the specs.
steps.point_out: All sources are listed with their types and specifications. The system confirms outcome-blind compilation.

steps.title: Check interpretation fidelity
steps.narration: Expand Interpreter. The system interprets sources while keeping Scout's original decisions intact.
steps.point_out: Each interpreted source matches Scout's original work. Timing and direction are preserved exactly.

expect.text: Foundry vs. direct-Scout screens equal: true

steps.title: Verify integrity and freeze
steps.narration: Expand Freeze and Integrity. The system owns the candidate count and prevents late changes after the epoch is frozen.
steps.point_out: The Freeze section shows the family count, lock status, and refusal of late insertion attempts.

steps.title: Test all decision logic
steps.narration: Expand Hermetic Oracles. The complete system is tested with all outcome types to ensure it handles null results, planted effects, and edge cases.
steps.point_out: Every outcome type is tested. The system counts candidates correctly and survives all safety tests.

steps.title: Confirm epoch committed
steps.narration: Expand Epoch and Manifest. The real epoch is created and saved without reading any outcomes. All sources are recorded with their disposition.
steps.point_out: The epoch is committed and saved. All required sources are listed with their status. The outcome-access count is zero.

expect.text: Status: Committed — Git-visible pre-outcome barrier crossed
